name: Tropix
author: 3dthc
summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.
